product_metadata.title: Set of 4 Clear 16oz Tumblers - Clear with Black Lid - BPA Free
features: Made from Safe Drinkware Acrylic - BPA Free - Great customizable cups
Insulated with Double Walls for keeping Hot drinks hot and Cold drinks cool
Simple pop on/off Black Lid to accept standard straw
Pack of 4 Blank and Clear Tumblers at bulk pricing
Smooth outer shell perfect for Vinyl Customization
description: This pack of (4) 16oz tumblers is perfect for the do-it-yourselfer looking to customize their drinkware for a wedding, party, or just because. Dreamslate's tumblers are BPA Free, double-walled, and come with a black lid that accepts a standard straw. These tumblers will keep your favorite beverages hot or cold longer due to their double-walled design. So keep your coffee warmer and your iced tea cooler. A smooth outer shell makes applying vinyl easy so you can customize these tumblers any way you'd like. Each tumbler holds 16 ounces of liquid and stands 6.75 inches tall with a 3.5 inch top radius.
